items.title: What Are UNH Stock Investors Betting On?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) stock trades at 22.5 times its past year's adjusted earnings, which are normalized net income with stock-based pay added back. That multiple leaves little room for error after three years of shrinking operating margins, sitting near the stock's 10-year median despite fundamentally weaker profitability. But the price looks different against the profit expected for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027. So what are UnitedHealth investors betting on.

items.title: 3 Reasons HUM Has Explosive Upside Potential
items.summary: What a time it’s been for Humana. In the past six months alone, the company’s stock price has increased by a massive 136%, reaching $391.06 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Has Gone Nowhere for Five Years. Its Dividend Has Not
items.summary: UnitedHealth shareholders spent five years waiting for a stock that barely budged, yet something inside the company kept growing the whole time. Whether that something is enough to make UNH worth holding now depends on costs that management has not yet fully tamed.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Jumped, But What Is Drawing Fresh Attention Now?
items.summary: Humana (HUM) moved sharply higher this week after Barclays shifted its rating on the insurer to Overweight from Equalweight, indicating that the shares could outperform sector peers. At around US$397.93, Humana’s recent 4.63% 1 day share price return and 3.21% 30 day share price return build on a strong year to date share price return of 50.46%. items.title: Why Humana (HUM) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of health insurance company Humana (NYSE:HUM) jumped 8% in the afternoon session after Barclays upgraded the stock from Equalweight to Overweight.
